title: The Verdict of Windrow House
author: Petra Brightwater
blurb: Dominic Vane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
